youtube_description:
Carter and Lee goes to Fiji for a vacation but it did not turn out what they expected.

Hey guys, for those that didn't catch the reminder in the title, in the beginning (green screen) and the end credits, this video is 100% FAKE, fan-made, concept trailer.

►Is there are real movie coming soon?

As of the making of this video, no official movie coming soon. This dream trailer was created in hopes to inspire fans, screenwriters, actors and directors so that one day it will come true!

►What Makes MacamTV Unique?:

I make fan made trailers as realistic as possible. This means avoiding actual clips from the franchise unless for flashback or transforming it using special effects. Otherwise the clips I use any clips that could create a realistic storyline.

►Why become a member of MacamTV?

As a solo creator, managing the channel takes a lot of work, such as researching, planning, making thumbnails, creating trailers and staying on schedule to release trailers every week. Your support will help me a lot!

Editing Details:

Rush Hour 4 trailer 4 was fun to make because I’m a big fan of the franchise. I think Rush Hour 4 is a must since the franchise has been everyone’s favorite. I notice the previews Rush Hour 4 trailer 2 was not well received because I did not have fresh clips of Chris Tucker. I used clips from his stand up comedy and talk show so it was not realistic. This time I was excited because I actually got clips from him in AIR film. Jackie Chan was not a problem because he has a new movie RIDE ON and HIDDEN STRIKE for his action scenes. The music I wanted to be action comedy vibe so I used the music from BULLET TRAIN trailer 2.

The best part was finding high quality deleted scenes from Rush Hour 3 movie. I literally had to watch Rush Hour 3 again to put the scenes side by side if it really was deleted scenes. Turns out it was, specially the scene of Carter and Lee supposedly going their separate ways but end up going to Fiji with the ladies. I find a clip of explosion in the jungle from Jack Ryan tv show which was perfect since they are in Fiji so it connects with the plot of bad guys in the island. There was a deleted scene of Carter and Lee with an old French lady in the elevator which I turned to be a recall from the first film “Do You Understand the word that is coming out of my mouth.”
